notes.default_posture: Production default is off; offline evaluations use audit. Shadow is the first live-observation stage and never consumes receipts.
notes.transitions: Promotions must move one adjacent step; skipped transitions are rejected. Live stages require human approvals.
notes.allow_token: allow-token-canary and enforce require an allowlist of reversible effects before receipt consumption may be enabled.
notes.rollback: Immediate disable turns receipt consumption off first, preserves redacted evidence, and may demote toward audit/shadow.
